bustools/large/barcode-map.txt.transformation: Deterministic user parameter: project first observed barcode onto the second; all other barcodes retain upstream default behavior.

bustools/large/capture-barcodes.txt.transformation: Deterministic user parameter: capture first floor(N/2) observed barcodes in lexicographic order.

bustools/large/capture-transcripts.txt.transformation: Deterministic user parameter: capture first floor(N/2) transcript identifiers in retained source order.

bustools/large/clusters.txt.transformation: Deterministic user parameter: assign observed barcodes alternately to groups 0 and 1; arbitrary test groups with no biological interpretation.

bustools/large/input.bus.transformation: Select first >=10000 records, extending through the complete last barcode; exclude records whose EC contains any transcript absent from the released gene map. Replace only EC integer with ascending-original-ID compact index. Preserve every retained barcode, UMI, count, flag, padding byte and header. Exact original source-record indices are recorded separately.

bustools/large/matrix.ec.transformation: Select referenced equivalence classes; losslessly reindex ECs and transcripts in ascending original integer-ID order. Transcript memberships are unchanged.

bustools/large/transcripts-to-genes.txt.transformation: Select gene-map rows for retained transcripts; remove only transcript version suffix to match the unversioned released transcripts.txt identifiers. Preserve source gene identifiers, symbols and order.

bustools/large/transcripts.txt.transformation: Select unchanged identifiers of every transcript referenced by retained ECs, in original integer-ID order.

bustools/large/whitelist.txt.transformation: Decode distinct observed barcodes from the already corrected source. This is an observed-barcode list, not an independent technology on-list or a cell-calling result.

bustools/read-index.bus.transformation: Replace flags only with the verified zero-based matching FASTQ read-pair index; retain barcode, UMI, EC, count and padding. Match unchanged 26-base R1 barcode/UMI with source N wildcard and consume duplicate matches in original order.

bustools/transcripts-to-genes.txt.transformation: Retain unchanged source lines whose transcript identifiers occur in transcripts.txt, preserving source order.

bustools/whitelist.txt.transformation: Retain unchanged on-list lines at Hamming distance <=1 from any encoded input barcode; preserve original order. This preserves every possible default bustools correct candidate for these inputs.

provenance/large-ec-map.tsv.transformation: Exact reversible integer EC-ID map for selected source records.

provenance/large-record-map.tsv.transformation: Exact zero-based source BUS record offsets for every retained record.

provenance/large-transcript-map.tsv.transformation: Exact reversible transcript integer-ID map; biological transcript identifiers unchanged.
